limitations: Local engineering evidence, not independent Anvil acceptance.
One sample per workload per phase; single-machine timing is noisy and is not a stable speedup distribution.
Go may stop at its one-billion-iteration ceiling before requested thirty seconds.
Full-module gates not rerun for this scoped package slice.
Linux and Windows are compile checks, not native execution.
Original-tests preceded adding Controlplane fixture-file binding to the recorder; every benchmark and retained test command binds those fixtures.
benchmark_scope: Ten deterministic workloads; all baseline test files restored through a Go overlay in after measurements. Production source changes only inside controlwire. Current benchmark post-loop nil guard and new Filestore-based fixture reader are excluded from both comparison sides.
